metadata.lookback: inclusive calendar-year window; OLS x is joint-observation ordinal, matching original model
metadata.snapshot: one fit over selected window as of observation date; earlier fitted Z is descriptive only
metadata.signals: refit every date using only that date and earlier observations; warmup requires full calendar history
metadata.entry: same-band first outward crossing, rearm at same-side 1 sigma or 12 calendar months
metadata.fixed_horizon: 1-6 calendar months from signal date; first shared date on/after target; common 6m complete cohort
metadata.convergence: 12 calendar months from signal; current rolling Z, not frozen-entry channels; common complete cohort with next-open exit available
metadata.already_reached: retained in detail, zero same-close reference, excluded from effective hit-rate denominator and lagged PnL
metadata.return_main: signal-close then next shared D1 open entry; fixed-time exit at target-date close; Z-triggered exit next shared open
metadata.return_old_reference: same-close event return retained separately for original-method comparison; not an executable fill assumption
metadata.position: USD 100000 each leg at entry, quantities fixed to exit, no rebalance
metadata.return_denominator: USD 200000 gross entry notional; not margin/account return
metadata.costs: gross only; excludes bid/ask, commissions, slippage, swaps, margin/liquidation constraints and contract lot rounding
metadata.path_risk: daily-close sampled MAE/MFE/drawdown, not intraday extrema or portfolio drawdown
metadata.date_limit: server D1 labels retained including Sundays; no proof of synchronized last ticks or synchronized first ticks
metadata.independence: nested bands and windows can refer to overlapping market episodes; do not compound or pool as independent trades
metadata.silver_status: XAGUSD daily series absent; gold/silver USD-leg research not computed
